payload.explanation: Diagnostic report_560dae2759c0 attributes the stuck inventory decrement to lock contention: the business session_73e55acc4895 is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_ab7ed7430055, an idle-in-transaction duplicate UPDATE. State report_ab393ed8159c confirms via fresh policy read that session_ab7ed7430055 is project-owned and eligible for rollback_session, while the business request session must not be targeted. Rolling back the blocker releases the lock and lets the business request complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes. Note the blocking observation may have expired, so current activity should be re-checked before executing the rollback.
